card.name: Start of contraindication lists
card.fires_on: The word "with" (or a list marker like "1." or "(1)") right after "are contraindicated in patients" at the start of a CONTRAINDICATIONS section.

modes.label: With after patients
modes.description: The word "with" right after "contraindicated in patients", before the first listed condition.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Salsalate tablets, USP are contraindicated in patients<< with>> known hypersensitivity to salsalate

modes.label: List marker
modes.description: A numbering mark that opens the first contraindication item.
